summary: Willow Lane Acquisition Corp., a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting the results of an extraordinary general meeting held on April 30, 2026. Shareholders voted on several proposals, including a business combination agreement, charter amendments, and other matters related to a proposed de-SPAC transaction. The filing only discloses vote tallies and confirms that the proposals were approved. As an 8-K solely reporting shareholder votes, this is a routine current report on a previously announced event, not a standalone special-situation category. The business combination itself has already been detailed in prior proxy filings.
